name: shadow_tier1_screening
description: Initial proximity analysis: is a detailed shadow study warranted? Buffers the building footprint by 4.3x height (CEQR longest-shadow factor) and checks for sensitive sites within the study area.

building_geojson.description: Building footprint geometry in GeoJSON format

building_height_ft.description: Building height in feet including all rooftop equipment

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction. NYC uses CEQR 4.3x buffer multiplier.

sensitive_sites.description: Sensitive sites dataset. If omitted, uses default NYC Parks dataset.

buffer_multiplier.description: Shadow radius multiplier (CEQR NYC default: 4.3). Override only if needed.

triggered.description: True if any sensitive sites fall within the shadow study area (Tier 2 required)

affected_sites.description: GeoJSON of sites within shadow radius

affected_sites_count.description: Number of sensitive sites within shadow radius

shadow_buffer.description: Buffer zone representing the longest-shadow study area

visualization.description: Interactive map showing buffer and intersected sites
